findings.title: StateDataset import resolves the installed scripts package instead of the bound trainer file
findings.evidence: The repository scripts directory has no __init__.py. Even after inserting the repository root at sys.path[0], Python resolves an installed regular scripts package ahead of that namespace directory. In the current local Python3.7.6 environment scripts resolves to E:/anaconda/lib/site-packages/scripts/__init__.py. The exact trainer main then raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts.train_e0_policy_refresh' at line92, before core.load_plan, collection checks or CUDA.

independent_reproduction.method: Executed exact main with a temporary plan containing the actual repository root. The real imports ran without package overrides. Independently importing scripts.train_e0_policy_refresh also failed.

findings.impact: The entrypoint cannot reach admission or training in a demonstrated review environment. It also does not deterministically select the exact trainer file whose hash the98-source map binds. The21 passing CPU tests exercise fit and the earlier helpers but do not execute this main import path.
